'''Pelissa Marsto''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Galactic War]] she was stationed on the [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pelissa Marsto appears ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a Jedi Consular gear vendor on Republic Fleet.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
